description: This file defines the UserController class in an ASP.NET Core web application, providing endpoints for retrieving the current user info and logging out, utilizing authentication and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core controller handling user-related actions such as fetching current user info and logout.

methods.name: GetCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves information about the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: Logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, clears session data, and caches relevant tokens.

methods.name: CreateUserInfo
methods.description: Constructs a UserInfo object from the given ClaimsPrincipal, including claims and a token.
